title: Resolution urging Albany to expand design-build for city projects
summary: The resolution calls on the state legislature and governor to lower the dollar threshold in the New York City Public Works Investment Act for using design-build construction. Current law limits design-build to projects of $10 million or more, or $1.2 million for Parks, NYCHA and a few other agencies, which the Council says excludes some smaller Parks projects like prefabricated toilet installations. The Council argues a lower threshold would let more projects use design-build to speed construction and control costs.
